exam_scheme.note: The Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT), an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India, offers its flagship two-year Master of Business Administration in International Business — MBA (IB) — across campuses in New Delhi, Kolkata, and Kakinada. Candidates are shortlisted for stage two based on their valid Common Admission Test (CAT) scores administered by the Indian Institutes of Management (historically, IIFT administered a dedicated CBT entrance via NTA comprising 110 MCQs across Quantitative Analysis, Reading Comprehension & Verbal Ability, Data Interpretation & Logical Reasoning, and General Awareness). Shortlisted candidates undergo a second selection round comprising a Writing Skills Assessment (WAT), Extempore / Group Discussion, and Personal Interview (PI). Final selection computes a composite score incorporating CAT score (approx. 50%), WAT/Extempore (10%), PI (25%), and Academic Diversity / Gender Diversity (15%).
